files.README.md:
# Fennimore Text Rentals - season registers

return_credits.csv records returned-book credits. Credits are stored as positive amounts; the month's net intake is the charge total with the credits taken back out.

Depot shelf
- Returns queue in the wire cart.

- Damaged copies box up for the recycler.
